widgets.title: Getting started
widgets.description: A short guide to arranging your dashboard. Remove it whenever you like.

widgets.title: Pomodoro
widgets.description: Focus sessions and breaks on a timer that keeps running when the Hub is closed. Counts today's finished sessions.

widgets.title: Notes
widgets.description: Quick plain-text notes with search and pinning, saved on this PC. Nothing is sent anywhere.

widgets.title: World clock
widgets.description: The time in other cities, with the difference from your own, day or night, and 12 or 24 hour display.

widgets.title: Countdown
widgets.description: Timers for anything: pick 5 minutes or set your own time. Several can run at once and keep counting when the Hub is closed.

widgets.title: Calendar
widgets.description: A month view with your own events, saved on this PC. No account and no sync.

widgets.title: System monitor
widgets.description: CPU, memory, network speed and battery, refreshed only while this window is open.
